breve: The analog threshold binding modifier can modify a float input to a boolean input with specified thresholds.
descricao:
The analog threshold binding modifier can modify a float input to a boolean input with specified thresholds.
See XR_VALVE_analog_threshold for in-depth details.

propriedades.desc: Haptic pulse to emit when the user releases the input.
When our input value falls below this, our output becomes false.
Haptic pulse to emit when the user presses the input.
When our input value is equal or larger than this value, our output becomes true. It stays true until it falls under the 'off_threshold' value.
